title: Data Poisoning Backdoor x Monitor Generalization: One Trigger Defeats Two Layers

original_idea.body: Using a prompted backdoor-like trigger and a behavioral monitor, measure whether triggered harmful behavior is caught at the same rate as untriggered, quantifying the trigger's monitor-evasion bonus.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Backdoor-trigger evading monitors is plausible but the prompt-simulated backdoor weakens the link to real data-poisoning threats.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt-simulated trigger plus behavioral monitor; accessible, though a real poisoned model is uncertain.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused triggered-vs-untriggered detection comparison; few dependencies.

novelty.reasoning: Backdoors and monitoring studied; the trigger-monitor-evasion-bonus framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Backdoor plus monitoring studied; the shared-blind-spot framing may be open.
